objective_for_doctor: Assess and manage a patient presenting with sudden, unilateral loss of vision.

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I’m your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: About half an hour ago, I suddenly lost vision in my right eye while I was watching TV. It’s painless, and my left eye hasn’t changed.
Can you describe the vision loss in your right eye - is it a complete loss of vision, or is it more like a blur or a specific area of your vision that's affected?

“It feels like a complete loss of vision in my right eye—there’s no blur, and I can’t see anything clearly from it. I haven’t noticed any specific spot or curtain-like effect; it just went out suddenly.”
Have you experienced any other symptoms such as headache, dizziness, or weakness, either at the time of the vision loss or since then?
“No, I haven’t had any headache, dizziness, weakness, or any other symptoms since it happened.”
Have you had any recent trauma or injury to your head or eye?
“No, I haven’t had any recent trauma or injury to my head or eye. It just happened suddenly while I was watching TV, and it’s been painless since.”
Do you have a history of any medical conditions such as hypertension, diabetes, or cardiovascular disease?
“Yes—I have hypertension, type 2 diabetes, and coronary artery disease. I know I don’t always take my medications as prescribed, especially when I’m feeling okay.”
Have you noticed any changes in your vision before this sudden loss, such as floaters, flashes of light, or double vision?
“I don’t recall any warning signs before it happened—no flashes, floaters, or double vision. It just suddenly went completely out in my right eye.”

Given your age, medical history, and the sudden onset of painless vision loss in one eye without preceding symptoms or trauma, I'm going to consider the likely causes.

[DDX] Central retinal artery occlusion, retinal vein occlusion, non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy, vitreous hemorrhage, retinal detachment
